title: Enumeration of binary vectors
statement: Define a list of binary vectors recursively: in dimension zero it consists of the zero vector; in dimension $\ell+1$, it consists first of the vectors obtained by prefixing $0$ to each vector in the dimension-$\ell$ list, followed by those obtained by prefixing $1$.
